name: Point-in-Box Inclusion Test via Sorted Indices and Bisect
aliases: Efficient Voxel Query via Sorted Indices and Bisect
Range Query via Binary Search on Sorted Coordinates
definition: Pre-sorts point cloud indices by x, y, and z coordinates to allow O(log N) range queries using binary search.
summary: This method accelerates voxel occupancy tests by pre-sorting coordinates and using binary search to achieve logarithmic query time, optimizing repeated queries on static data.
